name: Labyris
storyline:
Deep beneath the earth lies an ancient labyrinth, sealed away for centuries. Legends whisper of Jarduun — a demonic entity created through forbidden sorcery — imprisoned in the lowest layer of the crypt. As a seeker of truth, you descend into the maze, guided only by fragments of ritual scripts and your own fading torchlight.

Each layer hides puzzles carved into stone, rituals drenched in blood, and enemies driven by an otherworldly will. The deeper you go, the closer you come to unraveling the secret of Jarduun’s creation — and to facing the darkness that was never meant to be released.

Labyris is not just a descent into the underground, but into the fragile mind of those who dare to confront the unknown.
summary: Labyris is a surreal first-person psychological horror and puzzle game set in an underground labyrinth. Players descend into multiple layers of crypts and caves, where they must survive demonic enemies, solve ritual-based puzzles, and uncover the dark origins of Jarduun — a demon born of forbidden sorcery. The game features both single-player and online co-op modes, an immersive inventory system, and atmospheric environments built with Unreal Engine 5.
